title: Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. and LINKBANCORP, Inc. Announce Agreement to Merge
summary: ALEXANDRIA, Va. and CAMP HILL, Pa. , Dec. 18, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. (the "Company" or "Burke & Herbert") (Nasdaq: BHRB) and LINKBANCORP, Inc. ("LINK") (Nasdaq: LNKB), the parent company of LINKBANK , today announced the signing of a definitive merger
